Welcome to a World of Squishy Adventure!

Grow, nurture, and unleash a team of lovable slimes with endless possibilities! In this enchanting survival journey, breed quirky slime combinations, face wild island challenges, and embrace the thrill of adventure with your gooey companions. Can you raise the perfect slime squad to brave the unpredictable elements and explore as far as the islands go?


Features: 

  • Weekly Updates!
    Weekly updates with new accessories and items to increase the size of your collection and more!

  • Raise your slime in your own Slime Garden!

  • Breed Unique Slimes
    Discover endless possibilities as you breed different slimes, combining traits from both parents to create new, one-of-a-kind slime companions with unique abilities and appearances.

  • Feed and Train Slimes
    Strengthen your slimes by feeding them, raising their stats, and unlocking new abilities. Proper care is essential for building a powerful team that can endure the challenges of survival.

  • Dress up your Slime with Unique Accessories!

    Unlock and buy new accessories to dress up your own slime!

  • Roguelike Adventure
    Prepare your slime team for an ever-evolving island survival adventure, where every journey is unique. Face procedurally generated challenges, enemies, and rewards as you explore island after island.
